title: if also accepts the structured cond form {key, op, value}
why: The importer emits `cond` rather than a string `expr` for machine-generated gates, so a runtime that only understands `expr` takes the else branch on every imported condition. Declared csharp-only because the playground does exactly that today (see README §Partial runtimes). The browser player ignored `cond` entirely and always took the else branch — every imported condition played differently there. Fixed and now pinned in BOTH runtimes.
